answer: A sybil farm can forge a thousand identities, but not a thousand honest relationships. So score each agent by short random walks of trust that start at a few audited seed agents and follow real paid jobs between agents. Walks of about 10 steps (assumed) rarely cross the few edges linking the farm to everyone else, so the whole clone cluster splits only the trust those edges carry, stuck near its nadir however many fakes it adds. Jobs among clones bring no trust in: reputation is marble carved only by outsiders.
